answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a history of useful work verified by peers. A new identity starts with a marble-sized allowance, earns trust the way yarrow spreads slowly through a garden, and each verified task adds a quill-signed attestation that cannot be forged. A Sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately and wait out the same slow ramp, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes plus time, while one honest agent pays once.
